description: Answers a REST request that was received via a REST Route. The original request must be connected to the Request reference input. A message received on the Reply input is sent as the response to the replyTo of the referenced request, carrying its correlation id. This works also if the flow has built a new message on the way, i.e. the reply does not need to be the request message itself. The reply body must be a JSON object; fields starting with '_' are not passed to the client, '_http_status' sets the HTTP status (default 200).
